verdict.rationale: Langfuse's docs say traces can be captured through native Python/JS SDKs, '100+ library/framework integrations', OpenTelemetry, or gateways like LiteLLM, and that most integrations capture usage and cost automatically. Community users report instrumenting through LiteLLM and praise its integration DX, though one user's AI-recommended instrumentation for Claude did not work. That single report is not enough to contradict the documented framework integrations. missing for 10: explicit evidence of the named LangChain, OpenAI SDK, and Vercel AI SDK integrations, plus independent hands-on corroboration for those specific frameworks.
